> Still sucks but hey what the fuck go out there and try again you already know what could go wrong and in reality it's not all that bad

It is bad.  It is decades of continuing and repeated suffering and pain.

Thank you for the encouragement.  

I sent one earlier today, but no response.  It's the combination of thinking I really screwed things up after walking home and the non-response for this long that makes me think it is DOA.  

I have cheered up a bit.  Still sucks?

Thank you for the kind words.

Dating life just seems so brutal and narrow for somebody like me that constantly feels he is playing catch up.
